name: es31-indirect-draw
title: Indirect drawing
summary: glDrawArraysIndirect / glDrawElementsIndirect with the exact command layouts: 18 commands of both kinds at 4-byte-aligned offsets of one DRAW_INDIRECT_BUFFER (first, firstIndex scaled by UBYTE/USHORT/UINT, positive and negative baseVertex, instanceCount 0 and >1, attribute divisor 2, gl_VertexID), commands rewritten by glBufferSubData and by a compute shader ordered by COMMAND_BARRIER_BIT, DRAW_INDIRECT_BUFFER_BINDING, and every error of the section; every pixel is compared with a CPU model that interprets the same commands.
spec: ES 3.2 §10.3.7 Vertex Arrays in Buffer Objects, §10.3.8 Array Indices in Buffer Objects
ES 3.2 §10.3.9 Indirect Commands in Buffer Objects (Table 10.4: DRAW_INDIRECT_BUFFER)

ES 3.2 §10.5 Drawing Commands Using Vertex Arrays (DrawArraysIndirectCommand, DrawElementsIndirectCommand, DrawElementsInstancedBaseVertex, errors); ES 3.1 §10.5 (same commands, transform feedback error)
ES 3.2 §6.2 Buffer Data Stores (BufferSubData), §6.3 Mapping and Unmapping Buffer Data
ES 3.2 §7.8 Shader Buffer Variables and Shader Storage Blocks, §7.11.2 Shader Memory Access Synchronization (COMMAND_BARRIER_BIT, BUFFER_UPDATE_BARRIER_BIT, SHADER_STORAGE_BARRIER_BIT)
ES 3.2 §12.2.2 Transform Feedback Primitive Capture (Table 12.1); ES 3.1 §12.1.2
ES 3.2 §2.3.1 Errors, §20.1 Simple Queries, Table 21.4 (DRAW_INDIRECT_BUFFER_BINDING is not VAO state)
GLSL ES 3.00 §7.1 Vertex Shader Special Variables (gl_VertexID, gl_InstanceID)
GLSL ES 3.10 §4.3.7 Buffer Variables (runtime-sized arrays), §4.4.1.1 Compute Shader Inputs

api.glDrawArraysIndirect: TRIANGLES / TRIANGLE_STRIP / TRIANGLE_FAN commands read from byte offsets 0..: count, first, instanceCount (0, 1, 2, 3, 5), gl_VertexID = first + i, commands rewritten by glBufferSubData and by a compute shader; all pixels match the CPU model; errors: buffer 0, misaligned indirect, beyond the end (size - 12, size, far), default VAO, enabled array without buffer, transform feedback
api.glDrawElementsIndirect: UNSIGNED_BYTE/SHORT/INT index lists at firstIndex * size-of-type, baseVertex +4/+7/-2 (gl_VertexID = baseVertex + index), instanced with attribute divisor 2, compute-written command; pixels match the CPU model; errors: buffer 0, misaligned, beyond the end (size - 16), default VAO, no ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, type FLOAT -> INVALID_ENUM, enabled array without buffer, transform feedback
api.glBindBuffer: DRAW_INDIRECT_BUFFER binding set/unset (queried), ARRAY_BUFFER/ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER/SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER/TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER binding of the data used by the validated draws
api.glBufferData: command buffer, flags, vertex pool, palette and index data observed through the rendered pixels and the read-back of the commands
api.glBufferSubData: a whole command (D0) and one 4-byte word (D1) rewritten between two draws at the same offset: the second draw uses the new values (pixels); the compute input flags rewritten
api.glBindBufferBase: the command buffer is bound as SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER 0 and the flags as 1: the compute shader's stores arrive in the commands (read back word for word)
api.glDispatchCompute: commands.comp writes an arrays and an elements command from a count of visible flags: both commands read back exactly (3 and 5 visible flags) and drawn
api.glMemoryBarrier: SHADER_STORAGE_BARRIER_BIT before each dispatch (its stores must not overwrite commands still to be read by earlier draws) and COMMAND_BARRIER_BIT | BUFFER_UPDATE_BARRIER_BIT after it: the draws and the mapped read-back see the stores (positive evidence only; a missing barrier is not provably wrong)
api.glMapBufferRange: READ mapping of 12 command words of DRAW_INDIRECT_BUFFER: compared with the CPU emulation of the compute shader, guard words untouched
api.glUnmapBuffer: mapped command words released after each read-back
api.glGetIntegerv: DRAW_INDIRECT_BUFFER_BINDING: 0 initially, the buffer after glBindBuffer, unchanged by VAO switches (not VAO state), 0 again
api.glGetBufferParameteriv: BUFFER_SIZE of the DRAW_INDIRECT_BUFFER equals the uploaded command bytes
api.glGenBuffers: command, flags, vertex pool, palette, index and transform feedback buffers
api.glGenVertexArrays: six VAOs: index type (UBYTE/USHORT/UINT), color divisor 1 or 2, no element buffer, enabled array with buffer 0
api.glBindVertexArray: VAO selects the element buffer and divisor of each draw; default VAO -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: pool position and palette color arrays; an enabled array without a buffer makes the indirect draws INVALID_OPERATION
api.glDisableVertexAttribArray: disabling the buffer-less array removes the INVALID_OPERATION of the same draws
api.glVertexAttribPointer: float vec2 positions and vec3 colors from buffers (pixels); a NULL pointer with ARRAY_BUFFER 0 on a non-default VAO is accepted (no error)
api.glVertexAttribDivisor: divisor 1 and 2 on the color attribute: with indirect instances element = floor(instance / divisor) (cell E3 colors 0, 0, 1)
api.glBeginTransformFeedback: TRIANGLES capture active: indirect draws of POINTS -> INVALID_OPERATION (ES 3.1 and 3.2); matching TRIANGLES: ES 3.1 error / ES 3.2 allowed, chosen by the context version
api.glPauseTransformFeedback: while paused both indirect draws raise no error
api.glEndTransformFeedback: feedback ended; the following glUseProgram raises no error
api.glCreateProgram: program linked with a captured varying to make transform feedback active
api.glAttachShader: vertex and fragment shader attached to that program
api.glUseProgram: scene, compute and transform feedback programs; no error after glEndTransformFeedback
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_mode, u_scale, u_origin, u_pitch, u_arrays_word, u_elements_word located; their effect is observed in the pixels and the written commands
api.glUniform1i: u_mode selects attribute positions or the gl_VertexID position
api.glUniform2f: u_scale, u_origin, u_pitch place instances; every instance position matches the model
api.glUniform1ui: u_arrays_word / u_elements_word select where the compute shader writes: read back at those words
api.glViewport: per-region viewports map NDC to the probed pixels
api.glClearColor: background pixels equal the clear color
api.glDisable: DITHER off for exact color writes
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of every region (through demo::read_rgba8)

visual_review.notes: Viewed the gpu capture (256x256); the llvmpipe and zink captures are pixel-identical to it (compare: 0 differing pixels). Row 3: a skewed red triangle; three red/green/blue squares (instances 0-2); two fans (red, green) with a missing wedge; a red triangle on the left and right with an EMPTY gap between them. Row 2: a red square; the lower-left half of a square beside a tall skewed triangle (negative baseVertex); a red diamond; three half-diamonds red, red, green (divisor 2). Row 1: two lower-right triangles (red, green) and two left half-diamonds (red, green) from UBYTE/UINT firstIndex; two pairs of thin gl_VertexID triangles (red, green) and a larger two-triangle bow shape. Row 0: red triangle | green over red quads (glBufferSubData before/after); one red quad | blue/green/red quads (4-byte update); three then five quads (compute arrays command, 3 and 5 visible flags) and three full diamonds then five half-diamonds (compute elements command). Background is the dark-blue clear color; no stray marks.
